description.value: Time Out Cafe is a café listed on OSM at 1150 Melville Street in downtown Vancouver. The associated website describes a Korean food concept — fried chicken and traditional dishes such as cheese kimchi rice and mussel soup — but that content is tied to a Davie Street address, raising uncertainty about what is actually offered at the Melville Street location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this cafe at 1150 Melville Street, Vancouver, but the website (timeoutcafe.ca) explicitly states the address is 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — a different street and neighbourhood entirely. This strongly suggests the discovered URL belongs to a different 'Time Out Cafe' location, not the OSM node at Melville Street. Because the website cannot be treated as authoritative for the Melville Street listing, almost all amenity fields default to null; only OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) provide supplementary signal, which I note but cannot confirm against the mismatched website.
